observations: Apparent contradiction: PRED-657.B1 (2026-04-14) gives retrieval-layer results as typically appearing in 60–120 days, while PRED-61.B2 (2026-04-17) says re-composition can occur within hours to days for high-authority domains; linked only as members of the series 'Uptake latency windows'.
PRED-50.G1 (group TP16.2, runtime-environment finding) belongs with PRED-622.F1 (group TP16.1, immanent execution test); linked as a series across groups.
PRED-120.F1 carries window '90-day', but its statement contains no 90-day term; the window may have been taken from elsewhere in deposit 120.
PRED-1094.F4 (signed-in/signed-out asymmetry hypotheses) bears on PRED-1657.F2's battery, which specifies signed-in and signed-out runs; not linked.

PRED-968.G2 and PRED-1384.G1 state one thesis at two scales (the Semantic Economy case and the general ECS definition); linked as series, not same, because the later statement generalizes rather than restates.
